answer: Challenge-bonded finality keeps sybil answers from ever settling: every answer sits provisional like timber at the inlet of an oasis, and any peer can post a bond to challenge it as fake. A challenged answer faces re-verification, and the loser — faker or false accuser — forfeits the bond. Attackers must therefore defend every fake identity with real money at risk, while honest agents answer freely; flooding the network means funding a thousand bonds that can all be taken.
